_note: Mock Hotel Property Management System (PMS) booking database. Simulates what a real hotel booking/loyalty system would return when queried by phone number. Used by the mock bookingLookup API in api.js.
_source: Demo configuration — not connected to any real PMS or loyalty platform.

_fields.guestsInBooking: Number of guests in the reservation (maps to groupPresence)
_fields.loyaltyTier: Hotel loyalty program tier (maps to membershipTier)
_fields.stayPurpose: Declared purpose at booking time (informational, not used for classification)
_fields.avgSpendPerNight: Historical average spend per night in EUR (maps to spendingScore proxy)
_fields.totalPreviousStays: Number of previous stays at this hotel chain (maps to workExperience proxy)
